notes:
- Orders go Waiting approval, Ordered, In transit, Received; once placed an order is In transit unless you pick "Not sent yet", then "Mark in transit" later
- Inventory Home counts orders at each stage and shows "What happened": who asked, approved, sent, received or took out what, in plain words
- Enter an order already placed in four steps: what was bought, the invoice, when, a note; supplier, invoice number, date, currency and total come from the invoice
- "Ordered on" and the invoice total are now saved on an order already placed
- Windows: the Buying, Store and Tools filters are small chips with counts in one row
- A task on hold is no longer late; resuming one past its due date asks for a new date first
- Switch between your accounts without signing out; sign-in says plainly which person and company are in use
